desc: Prove that the valid suffix boundary is one greater than the deepest previous occurrence of any value on the current root-to-node path.
Implement iterative DFS with enter/exit events, cumulative distances, depths, last-seen rollback, and boundary rollback.
Apply longest-length and minimum-node-count tie-breaking correctly.
Run sample and edge-case tests, including a deep chain of up to 50,000 nodes, and fix any failures.
